get.summary: Frame-exact sync state from FPP's MultiSync clock
get.description: Returns the current media position from the native MultiSync clock, extrapolated with a monotonic (steady_clock) delta against a wall-clock reference so callers can schedule sample-accurate playback between sync packets. On players/remotes this requires MultiSync to be enabled (FPP Settings -> MultiSync); otherwise confidence is 'unresolved' and the PHP wrapper falls back to status polling. The native plugin also mirrors state to <mediadir>/plugindata/fpp-ListenLive/ll_sync.json. The legacy HTTP variant uses ?clock=1 to return the clock payload instead.

200.description: Sync state (always answerable; precision degrades to unresolved/stale rather than failing)

has_media.description: True when media is known and its position is non-negative.

seconds.description: Media position in seconds at the last sync packet.

extrapolated_seconds.description: Estimated current media position in seconds; -1 when no media or stale sync.

extrapolated.description: True when extrapolation was applied (last sync under 2 seconds old).

frame.description: Approximate frame number at the last sync position (44.1 kHz); -1 when no media.

last_media_half.description: Half-second tick of the last recorded media position, used for dedup.

monotonic_ms.description: Native steady_clock timestamp in milliseconds at the time of the response.

wall_ms.description: Native system_clock (wall) timestamp in milliseconds at the time of the response.

epoch_ms.description: Wall-clock reference in milliseconds used to anchor the clocks.

confidence.description: 'exact' when a recent sync packet and media are available, otherwise 'unresolved' (stale).

playlist_action.description: Most recent playlist action reported by MultiSync.

playlist_size.description: Number of items in the current playlist.

playlist_mono.description: Monotonic timestamp of the last playlist update, in milliseconds.

duration.description: Total media duration in seconds when known; may be added by the PHP wrapper or an updated native build.

has_duration.description: True when 'duration' is a trustworthy value for the current media.

server_monotonic_ms.description: PHP wrapper: server monotonic timestamp for round-trip compensation.

server_wall_ms.description: PHP wrapper: server wall timestamp for round-trip compensation.

get.description: Returns the native plugin's steady_clock and system_clock readings, used to anchor Web Audio scheduling without media. The PHP wrapper (/api/plugin/fpp-ListenLive/clock) returns PHP clock values when the native route is unavailable. In the legacy HTTP variant this payload is returned by /ListenLive/sync?clock=1.

monotonic_ms.description: steady_clock time since epoch, in milliseconds.

wall_ms.description: system_clock (wall) time since epoch, in milliseconds.

epoch_ms.description: Wall-clock reference used to anchor the monotonic clock.

source.description: PHP wrapper only: 'php' when the native clock was unavailable.
